description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the KpiDao data access object in the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It tests CRUD operations and specific behaviors related to KPI entities within the system.

classes.name: KpiDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for the KpiDao class, testing its methods for managing KPI entities such as save, retrieve, list, count, delete, and default KPI handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, creating a new KpiDao instance and populating the test database with fixture data.

methods.name: testSaveKpi
methods.description: Tests saving a new KPI entity and asserts that the saved entity matches the original.

methods.name: testGetKpiById
methods.description: Tests retrieving KPI entities by ID and checks correctness and null handling.

methods.name: testGetKpiList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of KPIs with optional filtering by job title.

methods.name: testGetKpiCount
methods.description: Tests counting KPI entities with filtering criteria.

methods.name: testDeleteKpi
methods.description: Tests deleting KPIs by IDs and verifies correct count of deletions.

methods.name: testUnsetDefaultKpi
methods.description: Verifies that all KPIs have their default flag unset properly.

methods.name: testUnsetDefaultKpiWithId
methods.description: Verifies that default KPI is unset for a specific KPI ID.

methods.name: testGetDefaultKpi
methods.description: Checks retrieval of the default KPI entity.
